```python
import hmac, hashlib, time

MAX_SKEW_SECONDS = 300  # recommended, not enforced by Orbit

def verify(secret: bytes, headers: dict, raw_body: bytes) -> None:
    ts = headers.get("X-Orbit-Timestamp", "")
    sig = headers.get("X-Orbit-Signature", "")
    if not ts or not sig.startswith("v1="):
        raise ValueError("missing signature headers")
    if abs(time.time() - int(ts)) > MAX_SKEW_SECONDS:
        raise ValueError("timestamp outside tolerance")
    expected = hmac.new(secret, f"{ts}.".encode() + raw_body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(expected, sig[3:]):
        raise ValueError("signature mismatch")
```
